title: SIU finds officers not criminally responsible in Toronto firearm death
article: The Special Investigations Unit has cleared four Toronto police officers in the shooting death of a man outside a movie theatre in Scarborough.
On Dec. 27th, officers opened fire on 34-year-old Paul Daniel, of Laval Que., while responding to a gun call in the Eglinton Ave. and Pharmacy Ave. area.
SIU investigators have concluded the officers actions were justified after Daniel pointed what appeared to be a black hand gun at them. It was later discovered the suspect was holding a pellet gun.
The SIU is an arm's length agency that investigates reports involving police where there has been death, serious injury or allegations of sexual assault.
